name: @mimir-stellar/telegram-bot
description: Telegram notifier for Mimir's Soroban contracts on Stellar Testnet: polls mimir-market and mimir-squad events and posts them to a chat.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
